summary: Reliability Audit Implementation Plan & Verification Matrix for Local Hub (Termux) Offline POS Synchronization. Covers Safeguards 1-4 (Sync Receipt ACK Watchdog, Reconnection Catch-Up with last_synced_timestamp, Inventory Reconciliation with STOCK_VARIANCE logging, and Tornado Burst Collision Proofing), plus step-by-step checklists for the 4 Reliability Scenarios.
